query:
SELECT
                    id_list.id as "id!",
                    CASE
                        WHEN osu_matches.id IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE
                        ELSE FALSE
                    END AS "exists!"
                FROM
                    unnest($1::int8[]) AS id_list(id)
                LEFT JOIN
                    osu_matches ON id_list.id = osu_matches.id;
